content:
Applications for the Prestige AEC Project, promoted and promoted by PTPC / Cluster AEC, and financed by Portugal 2020, are open until July 15, which is intended to collect and compile images of reference objects of Architecture, Engineering, and Construction in Portugal, for the publication of a representative author’s book of the AEC sector.

The Prestige Project aims to disseminate the excellence and real capabilities of national companies in the sector, in an approach to the Financial Multilateral market and through other internationalization actions.

Applications now open are intended to collect proposals to be considered and approved by a jury. In the end, this jury will select, according to the established criteria, which works to integrate the book.

The book will include two artistic images of each selected work, to be photographed by Augusto Alves da Silva, an internationally renowned photographer with a professional career in engineering.

Know the conditions and elements for application here.
